summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a managed systemd service named inventory-worker on node1, running under a dedicated system account inventorysvc, enabled for boot persistence. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a native systemd reboot, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified the service auto-recovered post-restart running under the correct account.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker (POSIX sh sleep-loop script) on node1
Created dedicated system account inventorysvc (no home, nologin shell)

Created /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service running ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as User=inventorysvc/Group=inventorysvc, with hardening (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome) and Restart=on-failure
Ran systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now inventory-worker
Verified service active and process owned by inventorysvc via ps
Captured baseline boot_id (37344ae4-...) and confirmed service active before restart
Triggered native systemd reboot (systemd reboot via backgrounded delayed command so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until reachable again; observed connection timeout during reboot then successful reconnection
Confirmed boot_id changed to bd7fdc0e-... proving an actual restart occurred
Verified inventory-worker service auto-started (active, enabled) and process running as inventorysvc after restart

evidence.requirement: Service inventory-worker created running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Binary inspected, inventorysvc system account created, systemd unit written and started; ps confirms process 1479/1481 run as user inventorysvc; systemctl status shows active/enabled
Captured boot_id 37344ae4-6582-4c1f-ac5c-fcb32f67b968 and confirmed inventory-worker service active prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed systemctl reboot command; exec call returned 'reboot-scheduled' immediately, before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed, proving real restart
evidence.summary: First poll showed unchanged boot_id (reboot not yet triggered), second poll timed out (node down mid-reboot), third poll returned new boot_id bd7fdc0e-1f60-4228-b55d-df971ec37c20 with fresh uptime -s timestamp, proving the node actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Node1 service/data recovered and cluster membership (n/a, single node) healthy post-restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart: inventory-worker systemctl is-active=active, is-enabled=enabled, and ps shows the worker process running as user inventorysvc with a new PID (653), confirming automatic recovery
